title: Mcp Gateways And Registries
motto: Enterprises cannot let every dev install random MCP servers. A gateway centralizes auth, RBAC, audit, rate limiting, caching, and tool-poisoning detection, then exposes the merged tool surface as a single MCP endpoint. The Official MCP Registry (Anthropic + GitHub + PulseMCP + Microsoft, namespace-verified) is the canonical upstream. This lesson names where a gateway fits, walks a minimal implementation, and surveys the 2026 vendor landscape.

steps.title: Why this matters
cards: A Fortune 500 has 30 approved MCP servers, 5000 developers, compliance and audit requirements, and a security team that wants centralized policy. Letting every developer install arbitrary servers in their IDEs is a non-starter.
